title: The CSV export names the payer as Customer with the saved term
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for, with its own IBS account number.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, on the Net 30 credit term.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced today, billed to customer B.
  • Start on the page that exports the invoice list.
custom_steps:
1. Export the invoice list to CSV.
  2. Open the CSV file.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A CSV file downloads.

Step 2:

  • Work order 1's invoice row, customer A's work, reads customer B's name under "Customer".
  • Its "Terms" reads Net 30.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
